draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.50, the 217th-best grade among 241 2018 draftees and 17th of 18 at DT. He went 195th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 sacks in 2017, 15th of 18 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 9 pro, currently with the Pittsburgh Steelers. 105 career games and 90 starts over 7 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 10 in 2020. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 6 (84th percentile). Versus the typical Year-8 interior lineman who played: 8 pressures against a median of 6, above the norm.
